newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. There were no trades versus none on Monday.
- One barge this week Illinois River (Spring Valley) bid at 105 percent of tariff, offered at 117-1/2 percent, no comparisons.
- One barge this week Illinois River bid at 105 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Nine barges, one each week May and June, Mississippi River (St. Paul through Savage) bid 2-1/2 points higher at 147-1/2 percent, no offer.
- Nine barges, one each week June and July, Illinois River, bid at 105 percent, offered at 115 percent, no comparisons.
- Nine barges, one each week June and July, mid-Mississippi River, bid at 115 percent, offered at 125 percent, no comparisons.
